description: Policy of the native USD map compiler (tools/quality/usd_map_compile.py): how a stage that passes source-authoring v1 or v2 becomes a BSP2 map. Decisions and their reasons are in RFC/0009-progress.md (U1, U2). Version 2 adds prop_dynamic, func_movelinear, trigger touch filters, entity I/O, targetnames, model-role checks and the static-prop bake policy.

texture.description: primvars:st is in texture repeats with t up (UsdPreviewSurface). The texel column is s * width and the texel row is (1 - t) * height, with width and height from the material's base texture as vbsp's material system reports them.

class_defaults_source: Valve base.fgd defaults Hammer writes for these classes (Trigger: spawnflags 1 = clients, StartDisabled 0; trigger_multiple wait 1); vrad's physical inverse-square falloff for lights. No FGD is in this tree.

targetname.description: Runtime entities that can be connection targets or probed get targetname = their sourcemap:id: one identity, no second authored name that could drift. Point entities and lights stay unnamed (an unnamed light is baked and removed at spawn).

trigger_touch_filter.description: sourcemap:touchFilter becomes the trigger's spawnflags (SF_TRIGGER_ALLOW_CLIENTS 0x01, SF_TRIGGER_ALLOW_PHYSICS 0x08); unauthored means clients only, as in v1.

connections.description: Each validated connection is an entity output 'target,input,parameter,delay,times' with the target's targetname (its id), no delay, and firing every time.

movelinear.description: sourcemap:moveDelta (Source units, from the validator) becomes movedir (the QAngle of its direction) and movedistance (its length); speed is movedistance / sourcemap:moveSeconds.

static_prop_bake.description: Every prop_static casts shadows into the lightmap bake: disableshadows 0, so the compiled STATIC_PROP_NO_SHADOW flag is clear, and vrad traces the prop's collision model (or its model's convex hull when it has no .phy). Collision none changes game collision only. prop_dynamic and prop_physics move, so the bake ignores them.

model_roles.description: A prop_static model must be compiled with $staticprop (studiohdr_t flag 0x10), which vbsp requires; a prop_dynamic's default animation and every SetAnimation parameter aimed at it must be sequences of its model.

light.description: A SphereLight with normalize off emits luminance L = intensity * 2^exposure * diffuse (nits); seen from any direction it is a disk of area pi r^2, so its luminous intensity is I = L * pi * (radius * 0.0254 m)^2 candela. vrad's brightness B with inverse-square falloff is the 0-255 lightmap value at 100 units (2.54 m). v1 maps full lightmap white (255) to full_white_lux, so B = 255 * I / (2.54^2 * full_white_lux), times the largest linear colour channel; the colour normalised to that channel is written sRGB-encoded (c^(1/2.2) * 255, inverting vrad's decode). The light is a point: radius only sets the intensity.
light.recalibration: Physically calibrated baking against Cycles belongs to R49/R51; a changed constant or formula is a new policy version.

tools.description: Full vvis and vrad (no -fast). Each stage runs one thread: the compile tools' own worker threads are private pools, so the stages stay serial until the engine job system schedules them (RFC 0003; RFC 0008 F6 / R57 run the stage graph).

errors.compile.authoring-invalid: The stage fails the source-authoring v1 validator; its codes are reported and nothing is compiled
errors.compile.model-missing: A prop's model file is not in the game content
errors.compile.model-collision-missing: A prop role that needs collision has no .phy next to its model
errors.compile.model-role-mismatch: The model cannot serve its prop role (a prop_static model without $staticprop)
errors.compile.model-sequence-missing: A prop_dynamic's default animation, or a SetAnimation parameter aimed at it, is not a sequence of its model
errors.compile.material-missing: A face's material has no VMT in the game content
errors.compile.light-unsupported: A light uses an input the v1 light policy does not convert, or converts to no light
errors.compile.leak: The world solids do not seal the entities from the void
errors.compile.tool-failed: vbsp, vvis, vrad or bsp2tool failed or produced no output
